news.body: Trupti Management Services Private Limited, Rockthree Framework Llp, Rocksolid Enterprise and Rocksolid Investments, Rajshree Nishad Shah, Nishad Jitendra Shah, Rajshree Nishad Shah, Parshwa Nishad Shah, Payal Paras Shah and others agreed to acquire an additional 24.98% stake in RGF Capital Markets Limited (BSE:539669) from group of shareholders for INR 37.5 million on March 10, 2026.  The transaction triggered the tender offer to acquire 26% stake in RGF Capital Markets Limited. news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.2% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Revenue is less than US$1m (₹1.8m revenue, or US$20k).
